subject: Discovery follow-up / schedule demo (technical deep dive)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up / schedule demo (technical deep dive)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful background on Acme Analytics' ingestion pipeline and latency targets. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary objective: move from prototype to production for semantic search + retrieval, target 10ms median token latency for typical queries.
- Data: ~12M documents today, expect steady growth; interested in prefix caching and embedding-based reranking.
- Compliance: SOC2 and customer-managed KMS are must-haves.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q3, procurement & security review in May.

Recommended next step: technical deep dive + demo with our Solutions Engineer to walk through the runtime, batching/quantization tradeoffs, and a short Q&A on security integration. Camila (AE) and Dev (SE) will join.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Apr 13 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu Apr 14 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Could you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend? Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda. I've attached a draft agenda and the requirements doc we referenced.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx, Acme_MA_Requirements.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for LLMs

Thanks for the recap — that lines up with our notes. Thu Apr 14 at 2:00 PM PT would work best for our team. Attendees from Acme: myself (Product), Tom Becker (Engineering manager), and I'd like to include our security lead (Samir Shah) if it's possible — I'll confirm if Samir can make it but wanted to flag the request.

Could you include a Zoom link and a 15-minute agenda at the start for the specific integration questions (KMS, VPC)? Also, can Dev show an example of prefix/KV caching behavior with our expected doc sizes?

Thanks —

jenna.park@acmeanalytics.com
